guardrails: planning artifacts do not ingest analysis datasets
planning artifacts do not execute risk maps, abundance inference, human case maps, Rt, spillover, host-switch, or surveillance joins
each source still requires provenance, terms, field-schema, and bias review before analysis

plan.access_route: NASA Earthdata Search, LP DAAC, CMR, or cloud access
plan.auth_route: local NASA Earthdata credentials if required; do not commit credentials
plan.qa_mask_rule: retain high-quality VI observations using product QA layers before aggregation
plan.rate_limit_policy: use CMR/Earthdata etiquette and retry logs; no bulk scraping outside approved APIs
plan.reprojection_rule: reproject to the harmonized analysis grid only after QA and compositing rules are fixed
plan.temporal_aggregation_rule: compute pre-specified seasonal or annual summaries after QA filtering
plan.tile_selection_rule: derive tiles from approved study extent before downloading granules
